top_signals.title: UK Watchdog Proposes Tougher Scrutiny of Microsoft Software
top_signals.summary: Microsoft Corp.’s grip on business software is making it harder for customers to switch providers, the UK’s antitrust watchdog said as it proposed tougher oversight of the technology giant.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
